title: Prove six-piece P112 concentration and exclude a literal caller
body:
## Summary

```text
Six retained P112 pieces: 4,5,5,5,6,6
  full support budget84
  D6 singleton concentration forces five pieces onto the axes
  remaining capacity8 cannot cover at least22 small-fiber sites
  E6 incidence146 <156

Delete four pieces from historical 4,5^3,6^6: excluded
```

Add one isolated proof/replay package, `research/p112-six-piece-concentration`. This closes PR3282's named literal caller gap without extending the false uniform cut40 contract. The earlier unpublished cut40 draft was retired after concurrent PR3286 appeared.

Global12/20 capacities, A2 joint22/32 bounds and the standard Weyl-chamber theorem remain explicit inherited dependencies. No full C5, global decoder floor, physical supplier, selected-frontier change or new kappa is claimed.

Credit PR3278/3267/3260/3262/3269, PR3282, PR3283's related eleven-label closure, PR3286, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 and the retained E8/P112 lineage including joaqcoo. Exact canonical-main and predecessor sources, hashes and unrun obligations are committed. Pending proof bytes are self-contained; fresh CI requires no foreign Git objects. [Canonical predecessor discussion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156).

## Evidence

- Before: PR3282's fixed inventory did not certify this row. After: the six-piece concentration and literal four-piece deletion proof exclude it, conditional on the stated inherited premises.
- Two exact algorithms agree on every new critical closure. The primary checks97,155/10,795 spaces per axis; the separate root/label reconstruction checks237,336/1,107,568 generating subsets per axis. Actual plane, small-fiber and Weyl-transport certificates are included.
- Registered CPython3.12.15 replay, ten optimized behavioral groups, Ruff, all17 final package/input byte comparisons and exact committed read-only Git-free CPython3.13.5 replay pass. Both actual verifier processes reject a corrupted closure receipt. Hosted CI is separate.

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p112-six-piece-concentration
```

No independent human or proof-kernel review, inherited heavy census replay, Lean, Docker or selected cold replay was performed. Open next questions and the family stopping decision are included.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only one new opt-in package. Frozen sources, shared tools and selected records remain unchanged. Archival retention is not supplier admission.
